reviews.text:
Alright guys, I don't even know if you truly read these so here we go. 
I bought..a 5 channel amp, a 10 inch sub, an 8 inch sub, an l.o.c and two 6x9 speakers. 
The l.o.c had a problem immediately. You sent a new one...and it worked but that is just a compound issue.
The sub blew... Completely blew, and you offered me an upgrade which is great but it didn't fit in the box... So... I had to do work on the box, something if think your " experts" checked when trying to recommend a speaker to me. 
The amplifiers rca ports came out... They plugged back in and worked but the point is that they never should have came out at all. They should never have slipped out of their mounted position.. 
Now... I'm listening to a particularly bass-filled song and one of the 6x9s started popping and struggling to even produce bass. Still clear on normal songs but it definitely can not handle bass. 
I know now after multiple conversations that you'll lean this towards my inability to install it correctly but the truth is....is that I spent weeks preparing for this install, comparing ohms to channels, watts to channels, I made sure.. everything except the 10 inch sub was well within its capabilities. I set the gain and filters appropriately to avoid clipping. I added deadening matts and made sure to wire everything appropriately, I checked and set everything with a multimeter and even have proof via chat gpt and consultation with an audio professional about how to do this.... 
I installed it all exactly as it should be including insulation between the Mountd and the speaker to reduce vibration that shouldn't even occur if I tightened it down correctly. 
I accepted the amp problem, I accepted the l.o.c issues, and I totally understand the sub blowing was my own doing but now...with the 6x9s failing  I can't help but complain... 
These 6x9s are rated 200rms at 4 ohm this CT SOUNDS AMP is rated 120 watt RMS at 4 ohm. 
There is absolutely no reason for me to be having issues with these 6x9s 
There is no excuse, even wired backwards (with hot to negative and negative to hot)
Coils do not work this way..they do not fail from being polarized in reverse. 
There is literally no excuse for the 6x9 to fail within 6 months while being powered less than 120 watt (I never cut the gain all the way up) 
So this is an issue with every product I've purchased and although you'd like so say it's my fault, I have plenty of research to point to the fact that it is not...
Severely disappointed. If you buy a product you shouldn't have to beg and plead and argue for the solution to its failures. 
The sub blew because of me... It was 650 RMS and I was pushing 1000. 
But the 6x9s and the amp..and the l.o.c???
This just screams poor quality control or just bad quality in general. 
I'll definitely be going back to my old speaker company, you make me question trying new products at all.

Looking at 2,595 reviews, reviewers overwhelmingly had a great experience with this company. Customers frequently praise the fast shipping times, noting that orders arrive very quickly and safely without any damage to the packages. People also love the powerful sound quality, solid build, and highly affordable prices of the audio equipment offered.

Some reviewers were not happy with customer support, stating they experienced long delays or difficulties getting help when equipment malfunctioned. A few consumers also mentioned experiencing delivery delays with specific couriers or receiving items that failed shortly after installation. Others noted that certain amplifiers or speakers occasionally arrived damaged or lacked the power needed for their setups.

Despite a few isolated reports of component failures or underpowered amps, reviewers generally agree that the items exceed expectations for the price.

Consumers find delivery service to be positive and reliable, consistently praising the exceptionally fast shipping times. Many reviewers highlighted that packages arrived within just a couple of days, sometimes even earlier than expected. However, a few customers reported isolated issues with carrier delays, damaged packaging, or delivery complications.

Customers consistently note positive experiences with customer service, praising the team for being extremely helpful and taking great care of them. Reviewers frequently highlight the excellent communication and support received during ordering and returns, with some mentioning flexible solutions for store credit past the return window. However, a few consumers reported slow responses regarding damaged items or unhelpful service when dealing with technical issues.

People report positive experiences with price, consistently highlighting great deals and affordable product options. Consumers mention receiving quality items at a fair price point that offers excellent value for the sound quality. Despite a few mentions of shipping costs or expensive stickers, reviewers remain highly satisfied overall.
